cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you zip the suitcase, the jam needs a sealed bag. Wool absorbs a leak; it doesn't contain it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've wrapped it twice in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twice gives you two sticky sleeves. Take it out and I'll check the lid before we pack it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the jar here. Problem solved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not until we've checked your jumper. Unfold it, please; jam doesn't stop travelling because the jar does.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 corrects absorbent wrapping, A3 patiently specifies proper containment with sharper sleeve remark, and A5 makes B leaving solution require another expert inspection.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 double wrapping causes A3 distinction between more wool and containment; B4 leaves jar and A5 shifts the same leak concern to the travelling jumper.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers a sensible way to avoid repacking, forcing A to create the next reason from the actual solution.

heightening.evidence: A5 keeps B occupied by checking the garment even when B has removed the proposed travel item, without directly asking for company.

specificity.evidence: A1 suitcase/jam and B2 jumper establish all objects used in A5 check.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 jam-travelling remark follows possible transfer into clothing, not a detached line about the card.
